info.description: Design only: unimplemented and unfrozen. Based on Feishu technical r51 / PRD r230 and user-confirmed Android-first scope. Backend and Agent are separate services. Database/model/deployment engines are not selected.

get.description: A camera filter is required. Time-aligned overlaps use [start,end); uncalibrated records are separately flagged, not asserted to fall within the requested UTC window. Default latest complete imports or explicit index_import_ids determine the effective clock mapping; snapshot and cursor pin them. Stable order: start ASC, recording_id ASC; unknown-clock sources are separately identified.

get.summary: Read source metadata and conditional playback window
get.description: Optional import_id pins the historical complete mapping; a foreign/non-complete selection returns 409 selection_conflict. Without it, use latest complete or report no effective import. Supply both window_start/window_end or neither. Playback is emitted only for available video with verified clock mapping. Metadata still returns 200 when media is missing/expired/deleted. Unknown-clock playback returns 409 time_unaligned.

parameters.name: import_id
parameters.description: Optional immutable complete import belonging to this recording. Omit for latest complete; pin this when replaying a saved query. The response effective_import_id and clock use the selected mapping.

post.summary: Import immutable index and real uploaded media
post.description: Validate unique basenames and exact file/manifest match, magic bytes, MIME, hash, size and all references; allocate private storage on the server. Publish rows only after validation/storage succeed. Failed transactions clean temporary bytes. No absolute local paths, bare storage_key or arbitrary media URLs are accepted.

get.summary: Search indexed events with coverage context
get.description: Requires a zone_id or camera_id. Default selects latest complete index per recording; the first page fixes versions and cursor keeps them. Order: start ASC, event_id ASC. Uncalibrated timestamps are not inserted into the UTC result set; coverage records the unknown. no_detections means not detected, never proof of no activity.

Identifier.description: Opaque immutable ID; a track_segment_id is not a permanent person ID.

UTCDateTime.description: UTC with Z; precision at most milliseconds. Query intervals are [start,end).

Cursor.description: Opaque server cursor bound to normalized filters, order and fixed import versions; clients must not parse it.

TimeRange.description: The server rejects start >= end; end is exclusive.

ZoneConfig.description: Image ROI and schematic-map position are separate coordinate spaces. A new ROI gets a new zone_config_id.

Clock.description: aligned_epoch_ms = raw_epoch_ms + clock_offset_ms. Unknown is not offset=0.

MediaUpload.description: A multipart files filename, never a local path or storage_key. The server checks bytes, type, size and hash before allocating storage.

MediaUnavailable.description: No media is uploaded. Maps to missing/expired/deleted/unverified; never available.

RecordingInput.description: For SDK event-only input use event_metadata + sdk_event_has_no_media; no frames or continuous coverage are asserted.

RecordingWithoutUploadInput.description: For SDK event-only input use event_metadata + sdk_event_has_no_media; no frames or continuous coverage are asserted.

Recording.description: No storage_key is exposed. Playback is null unless a verified retained video and time mapping permit it.

PlaybackAccess.description: Server-issued access to a recording window. Not persisted in Journey snapshots. Only emitted for available video.

TrackSegmentInput.description: SDK events alone cannot create a track. Discrete frame samples cannot be interpolated into continuous paths.

EventInput.description: sdk_event requires track_segment_id=null. Candidate action labels cannot be promoted to observed facts.

EvidenceInput.description: Context offsets must be both null or both known with a known offset_ms. The server verifies 0 <= context_start_offset_ms <= offset_ms <= context_end_offset_ms.

EvidenceWithoutUploadInput.description: Context offsets must be both null or both known with a known offset_ms. The server verifies 0 <= context_start_offset_ms <= offset_ms <= context_end_offset_ms.

Evidence.description: Metadata survives expiration/deletion. media_url is only server-issued for available bytes; all other states require null. Context offsets must be both null or both known with a known offset_ms. The server verifies 0 <= context_start_offset_ms <= offset_ms <= context_end_offset_ms.

CoverageIntervalInput.description: A frame_sample interval describes actual samples, not continuous capture. gap describes absent capture; processing status is independent.

IndexManifest.description: One recording per immutable import. All child IDs/references, camera, raw times and zone versions are checked together.

JSONIndexManifest.description: No uploaded or available media in application/json mode. File paths, media URLs and storage keys are rejected.

MultipartIndexImport.description: manifest is an application/json part; files is repeated binary parts with unique Content-Disposition filenames matched by manifest media.file_name.

IndexImportReceipt.description: Acceptance receipt, not proof of automatic-vision accuracy or a working SDK. Only complete imports join the default index view.

Query.description: At least a zone_id or camera_id must be specified. Server validates start < end and bounded query size.

IndexSnapshot.description: Pins exactly one selected version per recording. A cursor retains this set even when newer imports arrive. Non-complete sources are reported in coverage, not silently treated as empty complete indexes.

CoverageSummary.description: Processing completeness, capture continuity and media retention are distinct. complete does not imply perfect detection; frame samples remain discrete.

JourneyCreateRequest.description: References and user note only; the server validates refs against fixed imports and builds the factual snapshot. Arbitrary client snapshots/coordinates/facts are rejected.

EvidenceSnapshot.description: Server-built evidence baseline retains raw clock, mapping, location and context offsets plus availability at save; no temporary media URL. Server validation enforces the same positioning rules as Evidence.

JourneySnapshot.description: Immutable server-built factual baseline; no expiring media URLs/storage keys. Review actions only change human selection/grouping and decisions.

ReviewRequest.description: A split partitions existing selected item IDs; it does not create a new visual track or blind-zone route.

ReviewAction.description: Append-only audit; to_review_version=from_review_version+1. Actor/time come from trusted service identity/server time.

AgentRunRequest.description: The UI supplies visibly confirmed/edited filters. The Agent validates them again; a run cannot save human decisions.

AgentRun.description: Terminal stopped/completed/failed state is monotonic; no results are appended after stop acknowledgement. Candidate/unknown statements do not manufacture missing evidence.

ImportIds.name: index_import_ids
ImportIds.description: Omit for latest complete import per recording; explicit IDs pin immutable versions. One version per recording.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scoped by authenticated actor + operation. Same key and canonical payload replays the saved response before review-version checks; different payload returns 409.

BackendBearer.description: Proposed trusted service identity; server assigns admin/ingest/agent_read roles. Not a claim that authentication is implemented.

AgentBearer.description: Separate Agent-service client identity; backend tool calls use agent_read only.
